messages:
Priya: FYI customer ACME hitting rerank failures when they pass a very long query + ~200 docs. Error returned is terse and confusing: `400 RERANK_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE`. They think it's 'per-doc' but it's total. @eng-runtime @devex

Sam-ACME: Hey, reproducer below. Using our search -> rerank flow. Works on small sets but fails when docs > ~100. Error payload: `{'error':'RERANK_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE','message':'context too large'}`. No guidance on how big is too big.

Priya: Repro steps (curl):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query": "<~1200 char customer query>", "documents": ["<doc1 long...>", "<doc2 long...>", ..., "<doc200 long...>"] }'
```
Payload size ~3.6MB when base64/escaped. Query ~1.2k chars (~200 tokens), avg doc ~5k chars (~800 tokens) * 200 = ~160k tokens -> way over limits. Customer expected either clearer error or auto-truncate option.

Liam: Thanks. Can you paste the exact error response body + headers from their attempt? Also need the request `Content-Length` and a sample doc (just first 2 docs) to sanity-check token calc.

Sam-ACME: Error response headers: `HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request`, `x-request-id: abc123`, body: `{"error":"RERANK_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE","detail":"total input tokens 162345 > 65536"}`. Content-Length: 3720450. Attaching two example docs inline (sanitized).

Priya: Adding what we told customer so far: 1) split into smaller batches (top-k search then rerank top 50), 2) pre-filter long docs, 3) ask devs to compute embeddings and do dot-product ranking instead of full-text rerank for very large corpora. They pushed back: need better UX and clearer error message.

Omar: Engineering note: rerank currently enforces a hard per-request token cap of 65536 (total tokens: query + all docs + some model overhead). We return a generic error right now. We should return something like: `{error: RERANK_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE, total_tokens: 162345, limit_tokens: 65536}` and include a suggestion field with recommended next steps.

Priya: Customer asked if we can auto-chunk docs server-side or truncate docs to fit. Any risk?

Omar: Auto-truncation is risky — it changes ranking semantics unpredictably (truncating the end may remove key context). Server-side chunking+reassembly might work but requires significant runtime changes (maintain chunk ids and hop-aware scoring). Short term: add improved error with totals and link to KB + include suggested remediation steps (batching example + sample code). Longer term: feature request.

Liam: I can patch support KB and quickstart with a code example: search -> topN -> rerank top 50 + example to compute token estimate. Suggest we add a sentinel in the error message pointing to KB and show token counts. Priya can you confirm wording for KB?

Priya: Draft wording: "Request rejected: total tokens 162345 exceed per-request limit 65536. Reduce total input size by batching documents (example code), or use embeddings + vector similarity to pre-filter. See link: https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank-limits"

Sam-ACME: Would be great if error contained the `x-request-id` so we can reference incidents. Currently we have to include the entire curl payload in the ticket.

Omar: We already log `x-request-id` but not returning it in body on this error. We'll change that. Also adding a short-lived alpha feature flag for server-side `auto_chunk=true` for internal testing only.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-409 (P2) — "rerank: opaque limit error for large requests" assigned to eng-runtime.

Liam: Next steps: (1) Support KB update — Liam (ETA 4h). (2) Error body change to include total_tokens, limit_tokens, and request_id — Omar (ETA 2d). (3) Quick docs + sample batching snippet — Priya + Devex (ETA 1d). (4) Follow up with customer with temporary workaround + request for smaller batches — Priya (sending now).

Priya: I'll post the KB link and the workaround to the customer shortly. Marking resolved for support side pending eng fix. :thumbsup:

Sam-ACME: Thanks team — workaround ok for now, will request product team if they want server-side chunking later.
